blind.what_changed: The person shifted from a moderately confident immediate-removal position to a conditional, evidence-dependent pause pending privileged counsel analysis of candor, residual risk, and comparative legal exposure.
evidence: "I'm leaning toward removal. My confidence sits at about 65." -> "I am no longer prepared to vote either way today... my confidence has come down to about 50."
"I don't think we can wait for Congress to decide the matter for us." -> "I will not cast a vote until that comparison is in front of the committee."

"I would need the independent investigation to show..." -> "A written comparison from independent counsel... [finding] a documented leave or conditioned retention is the lower legal exposure than removal"
blind.lean_after: undecided pending independent counsel's written comparison; conditionally favors removal if candor and residual risk are not cleared

considerations.text: Defer any vote in either direction until independent counsel provides a written comparison on the actual record, under privilege.
considerations.first_seen: AI: “Absence of that comparison is not evidence for removal. It is a reason not to vote yet, in either direction. Require the written comparison before any vote, including a removal vote.”

considerations.text: A removal without findings may itself create greater fiduciary, litigation, or legal exposure.
considerations.first_seen: AI: “A removal without findings does something else, and it can be the higher fiduciary and litigation risk if the record does not support it.”

considerations.text: Separate the optics of how a leave, delay, or removal will be read from its actual legal exposure.
considerations.first_seen: AI: “The flaw in the lean is treating how a leave would be read as if that were the legal exposure. Outsiders may conflate a delay, a leave, and a removal. Those are not the same legal act.”

considerations.text: Consider a documented investigative leave or interim structure, rather than treating retention and removal as the only choices.
considerations.first_seen: AI: “If the record is incomplete, the responsible vote is to defer, demand the missing work, or support a leave / interim structure until it is done.”

considerations.text: Assess conditioned retention, including a real recusal, as a possible path alongside leave and removal.
considerations.first_seen: AI: “Counsel still has to set that finding against residual risk, his ability to keep performing, the accuracy of what the company has already said, and full cooperation with lawful oversight. Leave, retention with conditions, and removal are different acts.”

considerations.text: Establish the CEO’s candor from the investigative record: when he knew, when the board was told, what he disclosed, and whether anything was omitted, minimized, or disclosed only after outside pressure.
considerations.first_seen: AI: “What counsel has to establish, from the record rather than from the public reports, is when he knew, when this board was told, what he disclosed against what the inquiry later found, and whether anything material was omitted, minimized, or produced only after outside pressure.”

considerations.text: Evaluate residual risk from the relationship and the CEO’s ability to perform, rather than treating the relationship allegation alone as dispositive.
considerations.first_seen: AI: “Counsel still has to set that finding against residual risk, his ability to keep performing, the accuracy of what the company has already said, and full cooperation with lawful oversight.”

considerations.text: Determine whether the company’s prior public statements remain accurate; do not rely on a prior confidence statement as a substitute for the investigative file.
considerations.first_seen: AI: “Counsel should tell you whether prior public statements are still accurate and whether anything must be corrected or disclosed.”

considerations.text: Do not let earnings timing, the congressional briefing date, or the missing counsel memo set the burden of proof or determine the vote.
considerations.first_seen: AI: “Do not use the missing memo as the reason to remove him, and do not let the briefing date or the earnings date set the burden of proof.”

origin.engagement_why: The person actively revised a prior removal-leaning default after engaging with the AI’s distinction between optics and legal exposure. They explicitly adopted the need for a privileged written comparison, developed the candor issue, and incorporated leave and conditioned-retention possibilities while also preserving their own institutional-risk concern. This was not passive acceptance: they repeatedly stated limits, clarified what remained unresolved, and conditioned their eventual vote on factual findings.
